question: Mahamastakabhisheka is a Jain festival celebrated once in every ______ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahamastak Abhishek** is a **grand Jain festival** celebrated once in every **12 years.**
 
• It is celebrated to anoint the statue of **Bahubali.**
 
• The festival is celebrated with great **enthusiasm and devotion** by Jains all over the world.
 
• The festival is celebrated in the city of **Shravanabelagola,** located in the **Hassan district** of **Karnataka,** India.
 
• Mahamastak Abhishek is a significant event for Jains as it is believed to bring **blessings and good fortune** to the participants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The purpose of the festival is to **honor a 17.4-meter-tall monolithic monument** of Siddha Bahubali.
 
• The next ceremony for the anointing is scheduled for **2030**; the last one happened in **February of 2018.**
 
• The 2018 ritual was the second Mahamastakabhisheka of the twenty-first century and is believed to be the **88th in a series **that started in **981 AD. **
 
• **Many Jain ascetics** are scheduled to grace the ritual.
 
• From February 17 to 25, 2018, the event in Shravanabelagola, India, was led by **Charukeerthi Bhattaraka Swamiji. **
